test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'IFSP' is written as 'JHTR' and 'MPWF' is written as ‘NRXH’. How will 'TOAD' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'IFSP' is written as 'JHTR'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edf0af8cbe0d409bdd5f6ef18c100ae953d0efb6d63711dcde20a2199d327899.png] 

'MPWF' is written as ‘NRXH’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2d1572b6bffb582caf53b3a39979eeaf3af0f2e809523b3d9311b525de4f618.png] 

Similarly, for TOAD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a35a2c84b55f27a7d4ac51ba925a6255e0fdecf7da14c97addc525c0ce7519.png] 

So, 'TOAD' will be written as 'UQBF'.

Hence, the correct answer is "UQBF".
